#### lab-D002 — reset

**Type:** dialogue/trigger handler. **Source:** ` engine.js `; owner ` modules["engine.js"] `; script line 35.

**Status:** Current bundled source; execution is conditional on the handler and route.

**Local trigger:** Invocation of the owning handler/callback; internal guards are preserved below.

**Exact script:**

```javascript
reset(){this.state='menu';this.paused=false;this.hp=20;this.enemyHP=72;this.enemyMax=72;this.friendship=0;this.turn=0;this.selected=0;this.option=0;this.items=[{name:'MONSTER CANDY',heal:10,count:3},{name:'BUTTERSCOTCH PIE',heal:20,count:1}];this.bullets=[];this.effects=[];this.soul={x:320,y:321,vy:0};this.arena={x:176,y:253,w:288,h:132};this.invulnerability=0;this.clock=0;this.since=0;this.timer=0;this.shake=0;this.damageTaken=0;this.dodges=0;this.seed=12345;this.attackCursor=56;this.attackDir=1;this.text='* A TEST ENTITY blocks the way.\n* It seems willing to cooperate.';this.displayChars=this.text.length;this.practice=false;this.moving=false;this.jumpHeld=false;this.event='';this.emit('reset');}
```

<a id="lab-D003"></a>

#### lab-D003 — confirm

**Type:** dialogue/trigger handler. **Source:** ` engine.js `; owner ` modules["engine.js"] `; script line 43.

**Status:** Current bundled source; execution is conditional on the handler and route.

**Local trigger:** Invocation of the owning handler/callback; internal guards are preserved below.

**Exact script:**

```javascript
confirm(){if(this.paused)return;
    if(this.state==='menu'){this.state=['target','act','item','mercy'][this.selected];this.option=0;if(this.state==='item'&&!this.options().length)this.message('* Your pockets are empty.','menu');this.emit('select');return;}
    if(this.state==='target'){this.state='fight';this.attackCursor=56;this.attackDir=1;this.timer=0;this.emit('select');return;}
    if(this.state==='fight'){const accuracy=clamp(1-Math.abs(this.attackCursor-320)/264,0,1);this.lastDamage=Math.max(2,Math.round(3+accuracy*16));this.enemyHP=Math.max(0,this.enemyHP-this.lastDamage);this.friendship=0;this.shake=.15;this.effects=[{type:'damage',text:String(this.lastDamage),life:1.1,x:320,y:100}];this.message(this.enemyHP===0?'* The TEST ENTITY dissolves into pixels.\n* You won. 0 EXP. 0 GOLD.':`* You dealt ${this.lastDamage} damage.\n* The entity prepares its next test.`,this.enemyHP===0?'won':'defend');this.emit('attack');return;}
    if(this.state==='act'){if(this.option===0)this.message('* TEST ENTITY - ATK 3 DEF 0\n* An agreeable bundle of projectiles.\n* Compliments make it spareable.');else if(this.option===1){this.friendship=Math.min(3,this.friendship+1);this.message(['','* You compliment its excellent geometry.\n* The entity seems pleasantly surprised.','* You admire its work ethic.\n* It tries very hard to look modest.','* You tell it the test was a success.\n* It is ready to be spared.'][this.friendship]);}else{this.message('* You call its patterns predictable.\n* It decides to prove a point.');this.taunted=true;}return;}
    if(this.state==='item'){const i=this.items.filter(i=>i.count>0)[this.option];if(!i)return;const gain=Math.min(20-this.hp,i.heal);this.hp=Math.min(20,this.hp+i.heal);i.count--;this.message(`* You ate the ${i.name}.\n* You recovered ${gain} HP.`);this.emit('heal');return;}
    if(this.state==='mercy'){if(this.option===1){this.message('* You left the testing chamber.\n* The entity waves goodbye.','fled');}else if(this.friendship>=3){this.message('* You spared the TEST ENTITY.\n* A successful test. A new friend.','spared');}else this.message('* The entity is not ready to stop yet.\n* Try getting to know it with ACT.');return;}
    if(this.state==='dialogue'){if(this.displayChars<this.text.length){this.displayChars=this.text.length;return;}if(this.next==='defend')this.startAttack();else if(this.next==='menu')this.toMenu();else{this.state=this.next;this.emit('end');}return;}
    if(['dead','won','spared','fled'].includes(this.state))this.reset();
  }
```

<a id="lastbell"></a>

## LAST BELL — The Ninth Note

**Speaker key:** CASE identifies the mystery cast; CIPHER is the detective partner and Maestro the trial host. partnerLine is state-dependent partner dialogue. This is a separate theatre-academy world.

### Trigger map

- CASE contains opening, character/room/clue records, trial prompts/partner replies and timeline material. Selected room, evidence, conversation and trial state decide the displayed entry.
- partnerLine checks custom partner override, phase, ending choice and discovered clues in priority order. applyMove/handleClick preserve evidence and verdict feedback.
- The timeline-order and verdict sections are puzzles, not combat turns. endings records the different resolution choices; current selection logic is retained.
- Spoiler: Nao is the victim; Riku is the culprit. The clock/alibi discrepancy, playback and service-hatch access are evidence. A new line must not reveal information a character has not discovered yet.

### Banks, handlers and live events


<a id="lastbell-D001"></a>

#### lastbell-D001 — CASE

**Type:** dialogue/data bank. **Source:** ` entry / inline `; owner ` top-level data `; script line 1.

**Status:** Current bundled source; execution is conditional on the handler and route.

**Local trigger:** Bank declaration; use the references below for selection.

**Text occurrences in this bank, in source order** (includes labels/staging where present; alternatives are not one conversation):

1. ` The Ninth Note `
2. ` Mira Akiyama `
3. ` Ultimate Pianist `
4. ` If I put the ugly things into music, maybe they stay there. `
5. ` Her recitals leave audiences hopeful and her hands shaking. She dislikes applause almost as much as silence. `
6. ` Nao asked me to play something happy. I told him I don’t write happy music. He said, “That isn’t what I asked.” `
7. ` What did you hear? `
8. ` At 21:12, the piano started again. Nao’s little practice piece. I thought he was alive. Then I heard a cough between the fifth and sixth notes. My cough. `
9. ` Your evening? `
10. ` I was with Eden in the conservatory from 20:50 until the body announcement. Ask them. I recorded that piece here this afternoon, because Nao wanted to learn it. `
11. ` Why that melody? `
12. ` He called it The Ninth Note. There are only eight notes in the phrase. He said the ninth was the person who stayed to listen. Stupid. …I liked it. `
13. ` Riku Kurose `
14. ` Ultimate Stage Engineer `
15. ` A show only works if someone makes sure nobody gets hurt. `
16. ` The backstage safety officer who checks everyone’s harness twice. His own hands are never still. `
17. ` Don’t stand under the fly tower. Those weights can kill somebody. Sorry. Habit. I’m Riku. `
18. ` Your evening? `
19. ` Workshop. 20:50 to 21:20. Alone. I was repairing a trolley clamp. Sera borrowed my yellow trolley earlier, so don’t make that into something. `
20. ` The sealed door? `
21. ` The front door latches automatically. Everyone knows that. The service hatch is— …probably irrelevant. It’s a music room, not a bunker. `
22. ` What was Nao doing? `
23. ` Digging through the theatre controller. He said he found tomorrow’s “encore.” I told him to leave it alone. Sometimes knowing everything makes it worse. `
24. ` Sera Mikami `
25. ` Ultimate Restorer `
26. ` A crack is a fact. Covering it doesn’t make it a lie. `
27. ` Careful, dry, and very good at making damaged things look untouched. She refuses to restore the school’s security cameras. `
28. ` An academy built over a theatre. The gold leaf is real. The promise that we’re safe probably isn’t. `
29. ` The trolley? `
30. ` I borrowed Riku’s yellow trolley at 19:40 to move a frame. Returned it at 20:10. I wrote the return in the studio ledger. The smear on its wheel was already there. `
31. ` Your evening? `
32. ` Toma delivered solvent to my studio at 20:55. Stayed until 21:18, talking far too much. The short power cut happened while we were together. `
33. ` Could the room be locked? `
34. ` A locked front door proves one door was locked. That’s it. People get hypnotized by a good-looking lock. `
35. ` Toma Arata `
36. ` Ultimate Courier `
37. ` If the world ends, I’m charging extra for delivery. `
38. ` Fast feet, loud jokes, and a habit of remembering the parts of a route everyone else overlooks. `
39. ` You’re the new one? Nice. If a weird clock asks you to sign anything, use a fake name. That’s free advice. `
40. ` Your route? `
41. ` At 20:55 I passed the recital room. Nao was there with Riku. Yellow trolley, big coil of cable. Then I went straight to Sera’s studio. `
42. ` Could it be someone else? `
43. ` Not unless someone borrowed his voice, too. He said “watch your fingers” when Nao touched the clamp. It was Riku. I’m not guessing. `
44. ` Why joke now? `
45. ` Because if I stop, I’m going to remember Nao asking whether I could carry a letter out for him. I said sure. Didn’t even ask who it was for. `
46. ` Eden Saeki `
47. ` Ultimate Botanist `
48. ` You can’t make something grow by pulling it upward. `
49. ` Keeps a tiny garden alive under the theatre’s artificial sun. Quiet does not mean gentle. `
50. ` The plants don’t know we’re prisoners. I’ve been trying to let them keep that. `
51. ` Mira’s alibi? `
52. ` With me from 20:50 onward. We were repotting a fern. At 21:12 we both heard the music through the vent. She went white before the body announcement. `
53. ` The blackout? `
54. ` Eight seconds at 21:10. The greenhouse lamp timer logged it. The music began two minutes after the lights returned. That power cut did not happen during the killing. `
55. ` Nao’s secret? `
56. ` He told me not to water the orchids tomorrow. “We might all be gone by breakfast,” he said. I thought he meant escape. I wanted him to mean escape. `
57. ` Nao Shigure `
58. ` Ultimate Archivist `
59. ` A memory belongs to the person who lived it. `
60. ` Never deletes an embarrassing photograph. Says the person in it deserves a chance to recognize themselves. `
61. ` There’s a piano recording in the recital room. Eight notes and a cough. I’m learning it. If we get out, you’re all invited to my terrible first concert. `
62. ` Recital hall `
63. ` Where the music stopped `
64. ` The grand piano is open. Nao lies beside its bench. A pool of pink light spills from the broken emergency lamp. The front door is latched from the inside. `
65. ` Examine Nao `
66. ` The body `
67. ` Inspect the fallen watch `
68. ` Beside the bench `
69. ` Listen to the piano spool `
70. ` Inside the piano `
71. ` Inspect the fly tower `
72. ` Above the stage `
73. ` Behind the curtain `
74. ` Every illusion has a back `
75. ` Dust hangs in the rigging. A low service hatch connects the hall to the backstage corridor. Someone recently dragged something heavy through it. `
76. ` Inspect the service hatch `
77. ` Near the rigging `
78. ` Trace the wheel marks `
79. ` On the floor `
80. ` Read the controller log `
81. ` Stage control `
82. ` Open Nao’s envelope `
83. ` Under the console `
84. ` The workshop `
85. ` A place for fixing things `
86. ` Clamps, cables, old costumes. Riku’s yellow equipment trolley stands by the wall. It is missing one bronze counterweight. `
87. ` Check the damaged clamp `
88. ` On the trolley `
89. ` Read the spool register `
90. ` Equipment desk `
91. ` Check the return ledger `
92. ` Clipped to the wall `
93. ` Something still alive `
94. ` The fern on the table is freshly repotted. Eden’s lamp timer blinks 21:10. Mira sits beside a glass of water she hasn’t touched. `
95. ` Read the lamp timer `
96. ` Plant light `
97. ` Read Nao’s archive note `
98. ` On the table `
99. ` Medical observation `
100. ` BODY `
101. ` Nao died from one heavy blow to the back of the head. No electrical burns. A bronze counterweight fits the injury. Its impact would have made it impossible for him to play afterward. `
102. ` Stopped wristwatch `
103. ` TIME `
104. ` Nao’s mechanical watch stopped at 20:58. Its face was shattered beneath his body, with a dent corresponding to the fall. This supports an earlier death; it does not establish the time by itself. `
105. ` The identical cough `
106. ` SOUND `
107. ` The piano is an electric player piano with a battery-backed audio module. Its spool plays eight notes, then Mira’s cough in exactly the same place as the music heard at 21:12. The sound was a recording, not Nao playing live. `
108. ` Bronze counterweight `
109. ` WEAPON `
110. ` One removable bronze weight lies behind the bench. Pink residue and a broken amber resin chip cling to its mounting notch. It can be removed from a trolley clamp without operating the overhead rig. `
111. ` Unlatched service hatch `
112. ` ROUTE `
113. ` The front door latches automatically when shut. The low backstage service hatch has an independent manual latch. It is unlatched, allowing someone to leave the hall without unlocking the front door. `
114. ` Yellow wheel scrape `
115. ` TRACE `
116. ` Fresh yellow lacquer runs from the bench, through the service hatch, toward the workshop. The scrape spacing matches the yellow equipment trolley. Other academy carts are blue. `
117. ` Playback cue log `
118. ` RECORD `
119. ` At 21:02 the local stage controller scheduled spool 38 for 21:12. Authorization: Riku’s assigned wristband R-17. The log records the band, not the wearer. The player’s battery module survives brief power cuts. `
120. ` Nao’s unopened letter `
121. ` MOTIVE `
122. ` “Riku: the encore protocol is real. At 06:00 it wipes our personal archives and opens the exhaust vents. I’m copying proof. Please don’t smash the controller; I still need its override. Meet me before nine. — Nao” `
123. ` Broken resin clamp `
124. ` MATCH `
125. ` The yellow trolley’s clamp has a fresh triangular break in its amber repair resin. The loose chip on the bronze weapon fits that break. This links the weapon to the trolley, though the trolley could have been borrowed. `
126. ` Spool 38 register `
127. ` RECORD `
128. ` Mira recorded spool 38 at 15:40. At 20:46, Riku signed it out with his R-17 band. No later handover is recorded. His nearby repair worksheet was never stamped that evening. `
129. ` Sera’s return ledger `
130. ` ALIBI `
131. ` Sera returned the yellow trolley at 20:10. Riku countersigned the return at 20:14. Toma’s delivery slip places him in Sera’s studio from 20:55 to 21:18. Her earlier borrowing cannot explain its use near 20:58. `
132. ` Eight-second blackout `
133. ` TIME `
134. ` The conservatory timer logs a power interruption from 21:10:00 to 21:10:08. Eden and Mira were together here throughout. The music began at 21:12, after the lights returned. `
135. ` Nao’s copied override `
136. ` SECRET `
137. ` Nao hid a complete copy of the encore override with Eden. His note says: “If I don’t come back, the shutdown phrase is NINTH NOTE. Read the evidence before you trust the show.” `
138. ` Toma’s corridor sighting `
139. ` WITNESS `
140. ` At 20:55 Toma saw and heard Riku with Nao in the recital hall, beside the yellow trolley. He then stayed with Sera until 21:18. This contradicts Riku’s claim to have been alone in the workshop from 20:50. `
141. ` SYSTEM `
142. ` An audience of seven. `
143. ` You wake under a theatre seat with an admission ticket folded in your hand. Your name is printed beneath a title you never earned: ULTIMATE WITNESS. Six other students are waiting in the aisle. The doors have no handles on this side. `
144. ` MAESTRO `
145. ` Welcome to the final performance. `
146. ` The great clock above the stage speaks in a voice much too cheerful for its face. “A murder earns one of you an exit. Find the culprit in our class trial, and the rest survive. Choose wrong, and the killer takes the curtain call alone.” `
147. ` CIPHER `
148. ` A very small objection. `
149. ` A portable monitor flickers beside your seat. “(^_^;) Hello. I am CIPHER. Apparently my official talent is Ultimate Unnecessary Expense. I can remember what you find. I cannot decide what it means for you.” You lift it from the floor. “Oh. You are taking me with you. That is… statistically kind.” `
150. ` The ninth note. `
151. ` Nao sits at the grand piano, playing a phrase badly and laughing when he misses its ending. “Mira says there isn’t a ninth note. I think there is. It’s whoever stays to listen.” The others have gathered in the hall. For a moment, it almost feels like school. `
152. ` SYSTEM `
153. ` 21:30 / Body discovery. `
154. ` The announcement interrupts a melody coming from the recital hall. Nao is on the floor beside the piano bench. The main door was latched. You heard him playing eighteen minutes ago. Or you heard something that sounded like him. `
155. ` MAESTRO `
156. ` A living sound `
157. ` We all heard Nao playing at 21:12. He was alive then. What other explanation could there be? `
158. ` “The music proves Nao was alive at 21:12.” `
159. ` Those eight notes included the exact cough from Mira’s afternoon recording. A machine played the sound. Hearing music is not the same as hearing a living person. `
160. ` (^_^;) A sound can be honest about what it is and still lie about who made it. Compare the recordings. `
161. ` What tells you whether the performance was live? `
162. ` RIKU `
163. ` A convenient darkness `
164. ` The power cut was at 21:10. Someone used those eight seconds to kill him. That has to be when it happened. `
165. ` “Nao was killed during the 21:10 blackout.” `
166. ` The shattered watch supports a collapse at 20:58, twelve minutes before the outage. Together with the recorded performance and injury, it breaks the blackout theory. `
167. ` (•_•) The loudest event is not necessarily the important event. What was already broken before the lights went out? `
168. ` A damaged object supports an earlier collapse. `
169. ` SERA `
170. ` One door is not a room `
171. ` Fine. An earlier death. But the door was locked from inside. If nobody could leave, the killer stayed with the body. `
172. ` “The killer could not leave the locked recital hall.” `
173. ` The front door latches by itself, but the service hatch has its own manual latch. It was left open. The room was never sealed. `
174. ` (¬_¬) Architecture has more authority here than confidence. Check every way out. `
175. ` How many entrances did you actually examine? `
176. ` RIKU `
177. ` Borrowed guilt `
178. ` That trolley was in Sera’s hands. If its clamp matches the weapon, you know who to look at. I was in my workshop. `
179. ` “Sera still had my trolley when Nao died.” `
180. ` Sera returned it at 20:10, and Riku countersigned at 20:14. Toma’s delivery places her in the studio at 20:55. Her earlier borrowing is a distraction. `
181. ` (._.) A true fact can be placed in the wrong hour. Put the borrowing back on the clock. `
182. ` Who had possession of the trolley at the relevant time? `
183. ` RIKU `
184. ` The empty workshop `
185. ` I told you. Workshop. 20:50 to 21:20. Nobody saw me leave. You can’t just invent me being in that room. `
186. ` “I was alone in the workshop from 20:50 to 21:20.” `
187. ` Toma saw and heard Riku with Nao in the hall at 20:55. That breaks the alibi and puts him with the trolley immediately before the supported death time. `
188. ` (•̀_•́) Not all evidence is an object. Someone remembers a voice. `
189. ` A classmate’s delivery route passes the hall. `
190. ` MAESTRO `
191. ` An encore without a performer `
192. ` Perhaps the music started itself during the outage. Such a wonderfully convenient accident. Nobody needed to arrange a thing! `
193. ` “The 21:12 playback was an accident caused by the blackout.” `
194. ` A deliberate 21:02 cue scheduled spool 38 for 21:12. The battery-backed player survived the outage. Someone arranged a false performance after Nao’s death. `
195. ` (>_<) The machine did what it was told. Find the instruction. `
196. ` Which record distinguishes a scheduled action from an accident? `
197. ` Riku meets Nao in the hall `
198. ` Nao falls; his watch breaks `
199. ` The false performance is scheduled `
200. ` The lights fail for eight seconds `
201. ` Spool 38 plays eight notes and a cough `

function applyMove(m){if(!m||typeof m!=='object'||Array.isArray(m)||m.case!==CASE.id||m.revision!==state.revision)throw Error('This move is for a different or older notebook. Copy a fresh handoff and ask for a new move.');if(m.text!==undefined&&(typeof m.text!=='string'||m.text.length>1500))throw Error('Partner notes must be text under 1500 characters.');const permitted=actionsNow().some(x=>x.action===m.action);if(!permitted)throw Error('That move is not available at this point in the case.');const known=new Set(['case','revision','action','text','id','topic','order']);if(Object.keys(m).some(k=>!known.has(k)))throw Error('The reply includes unrecognized fields.');if(m.action==='partner'&&!m.text?.trim())throw Error('The partner note is empty.');if(m.action==='visit'&&!CASE.rooms.some(r=>r.id===m.id))throw Error('Unknown location.');if(m.action==='inspect'&&!CASE.rooms.find(r=>r.id===state.room).spots.some(x=>x[0]===m.id))throw Error('Visit that location first.');if(m.action==='talk'&&(!CASE.cast.find(c=>c.id===m.id)?.talk||!Number.isInteger(m.topic)||m.topic<0||m.topic>2))throw Error('Unknown classmate or question.');if(m.action==='present'&&(!state.found.includes(m.id)||state.result||state.hope<=0))throw Error('You cannot present this evidence now.');if(m.action==='accuse'&&!CASE.cast.some(c=>c.id===m.id&&c.id!=='nao'))throw Error('Unknown suspect.');if(m.action==='order'&&(!Array.isArray(m.order)||m.order.length!==5||new Set(m.order).size!==5||m.order.some(id=>!CASE.timeline.some(t=>t.id===id))))throw Error('The reconstruction must contain all five event ids exactly once.');state.partnerTurns++;if(m.text)state.partner=m.text;state.tab='explore';close();switch(m.action){case'partner':state.tab='partner';persist();break;case'visit':state.room=m.id;persist();break;case'inspect':inspect(m.id);break;case'talk':personModal(m.id,m.topic);break;case'present':present(m.id);break;case'accuse':vote(m.id);break;case'begin_trial':startTrial();break;case'order':state.order=[...m.order];persist();break;}toast('Partner move applied.');return {phase:state.phase,revision:state.revision,partnerTurns:state.partnerTurns};}

<a id="ant"></a>

## Ant vs Termite — Colony Simulation

**Speaker key:** System notifications and colony UI. There are no authored speaking ant/termite characters in this corpus.

### Trigger map

- Satellite nests, termite succession, invasions and royal actors emit state-change notices. Tool application, erasure and control clicks emit interface feedback.
- Keep these messages separate from character dialogue and Underground lore. State/configuration descriptions are simulator text, not a hidden NPC monologue.

### Banks, handlers and live events


<a id="ant-D001"></a>

#### ant-D001 — reset

**Type:** dialogue/trigger handler. **Source:** ` entry / inline `; owner ` reset `; script line 494.

**Status:** Current bundled source; execution is conditional on the handler and route.

**Local trigger:** Invocation of the owning handler/callback; internal guards are preserved below.

**Exact script:**

```javascript
function reset() {
  state.paused = false;
  state.view = "surface";
  state.time = 0;
  state.foodStore = 34;
  state.antColony = {
    health: 130,
    maxHealth: 130,
    queenHealth: 100,
    nestSize: 1,
    nurseryLevel: 1,
    storageLevel: 1,
    breach: 0,
    shrinkDebt: 0,
    carve: 0,
    chamberDamage: makeAntChamberDamage(),
    queen: makeRoyalActor("antQueen", "queen"),
    eggs: 10,
    larvae: 6,
    pupae: 4,
    nurseCare: 0,
  };
  state.termiteColony = {
    health: 260,
    maxHealth: 260,
    queenHealth: 100,
    kingHealth: 100,
    primaryQueenAlive: true,
    primaryKingAlive: true,
    secondaryQueens: 0,
    secondaryKings: 0,
    successionProgress: 0,
    eggs: 26,
    nymphs: 18,
    cellulose: 80,
    humidity: 96,
    fortification: 100,
    nestSize: 1.4,
    nurseryLevel: 1,
    storageLevel: 1,
    breach: 0,
    shrinkDebt: 0,
    carve: 0,
    alarm: 0,
    chamberDamage: makeTermiteChamberDamage(),
    queen: makeRoyalActor("termiteQueen", "royal"),
    king: makeRoyalActor("termiteKing", "royal"),
    successors: [],
  };
  state.ants = [];
  state.termites = [];
  state.foods = [];
  state.woods = [];
  state.barriers = [];
  state.rallies = [];
  state.pheromones = [];
  state.mudTubes = [];
  state.particles = [];
  state.satelliteNests = [];
  state.magnifier.active = false;
  state.antTactic = "Forage trails";
  state.termiteTactic = "Fortify galleries";
  hud.message.hidden = true;
  hud.pauseIcon.textContent = "II";

  const initialAnts = [
    ["forager", 14],
    ["nurse", 7],
    ["builder", 4],
    ["guard", 5],
    ["soldier", 2],
  ];
  for (const [role, count] of initialAnts) for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) addAnt(role);

  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i += 1) addTermite(i < 5 ? "soldier" : "worker");

  const n = nest();
  const m = mound();
  addFood(state.width * 0.33, state.height * 0.27, 28);
  addFood(state.width * 0.45, state.height * 0.68, 22);
  addFood(lerp(n.x, m.x, 0.48), state.height * 0.44, 18);
  addWood(state.width * 0.61, state.height * 0.5, 45);
  addWood(state.width * 0.74, state.height * 0.28, 32);
  state.mudTubes.push({ x1: m.x, y1: m.y, x2: state.width * 0.7, y2: state.height * 0.52, life: 1 });
  applyScenarioFromQuery();
}
```
